onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.intro: A few settings, then we begin. Everything stays on this phone or computer; nothing is sent anywhere.
onboarding.config: How we go through the course
onboarding.config.solo: One Dreamer and their Dream Friend
onboarding.start: Date of the module 1 meeting (the first meeting with exercises)
onboarding.start.friend: Date of the module 1 meeting (the first meeting with the Dreamer)
onboarding.start.group: Date of the module 1 meeting (in a group: the same for everyone)
onboarding.start.help: If the day of the first meeting is not settled yet, leave the date empty; you fill the date in under Settings after module 0.
onboarding.cadence.help: With fewer than 14 days, the two-week exercises in modules 4 and 5 do not fit.
onboarding.paper: I keep my dream list on paper
onboarding.paper.help: The Dream Book is the notebook you write in by hand. If you tick this, the app does not ask you to copy your dreams here: you note only how many dreams are in the notebook and, from module 2, you write the one dream you work on in a single box. You do not have to decide now; change it any time in Settings.
onboarding.lang: Interface language (the course text is in Romanian)
onboarding.theme.help: "Like the device" follows the light or dark mode set on the phone or computer; change it any time in Settings.
home.first.help: Start with module 0: it tells you what the Dream Book is, how the meetings work and what to do before the first one.
home.lead.other: The other one leads this meeting.
home.next.none: No first-meeting date set yet. Set it in Settings.
home.next.allDone: You have been through all the modules. Keep going: the small step (daily) and the sentence to your progress partner (weekly, until three months after the course). Coming up: the vision check-in on the date in your calendar (Vision page) and the letter from your future self, on the date you chose. Any time: "Letting the dream go with honour", on the My dream page.
home.next.allDone.friend: You have held all seven meetings. From here on: three more months of the weekly sentence from those who chose you as progress partner; you answer with one sentence about what they did, without advice. Each person does the vision check-in alone.
home.plans.none: No plan yet. You write one at the end of each module, in "Until next time".
home.plans.done: Done with this plan (hide it from here)
home.plans.help: Weekly plans stay here as long as you do them; hide them only when they are no longer to be done.
home.chosen: The dream I am working on
home.chosen.none: No dream chosen yet. You choose the dream you work on in module 2.
home.friendMode: At the next meeting I lead (Dream Friend)
home.friendMode.help: The tick switches by itself when you press "The meeting took place" on the module page. The module page shows the mark "I lead", so that you open the plan from the menu, under Dream Friend. If you both have the tick, decide on the spot who leads and correct it here.
modules.title: Modules
modules.locked.none: You can open any module at any time. We recommend the order below.
module.friend.variant.solo: One Dreamer and their Dream Friend
module.next.plan: Turn what you will do until next time into a concrete plan: "if [situation], then [action]". For example: if it is Sunday evening after dinner, then I write three dreams in my book.
module.next.if.placeholder: e.g. it is Sunday evening after dinner
module.next.then.placeholder: e.g. I write three dreams in my book
module.next.saved: Plan saved. You will find it on the Home page.
module.feedback: One word for how the meeting was
module.takeaways.placeholder: What stayed with you from this module: an idea, an exercise, an aha moment. Two or three lines are enough; you reread these notes in the last module.
module.contentFallback: The course text is only in Romanian; the interface is in the language chosen in Settings.
module.notFound: There is no module with this number. Choose a module from the list.
dreams.title: The 100 dreams list
dreams.add.label: A new dream
dreams.paper: You keep the list on paper. Here you note only how many dreams are in your notebook and, from module 2, the dream you work on.
dreams.paper.chosen: The dream I work on (copied from the notebook)
dreams.paper.chosen.placeholder: for example: ten days on foot through the Apuseni mountains, with my sister
dreams.paper.count: How many dreams have you written in your Dream Book (notebook)?
dreams.tag.help: From inside: growth, relationships, contribution, health. From outside: money, image, status.
dreams.score: Importance (1 = low, 10 = huge), by your criteria below
dreams.choose: Choose this dream (I work on it)
dreams.release: Let this dream go (stays in the list, marked)
dreams.warn.extrinsic: Your highest-scored dreams are all "from outside" (money, image, status). Not wrong, but worth a pause before choosing the dream you work on.
dreams.criteria.help: Write the criteria you use to score each dream's importance, in your own words (for example: "brings me closer to my family"). One criterion is always there and cannot be deleted: "how I feel when I think of this dream".
dreams.criteria.fixed: How I feel when I think of this dream
dreams.criteria.placeholder: e.g. brings me closer to the people I love
dreams.empty: The list is empty. Type your first dream in the field above; maybe a childhood one.
letter.label: Letter of the COPIL method
book.title: Printable sheets for the Dream Book
book.intro: All the sheets are here from the start; next to each one it says which module it is from. Choose a sheet or print the whole book. A4 or Letter, black and white. As a Dream Friend, this is where you print the sheets you use at meetings (for example "The obstacle (WOOP)" for module 3).
friend.title: Dream Friend page
friend.hidden: This page appears only when the chosen role is Dream Friend or Both. Change the role in Settings.
friend.notes.both: My notes about the meeting (kept apart from my own list and plans)
friend.notes.placeholder: e.g. spoke easily about childhood dreams; got stuck at the written list
friend.notes.empty: No note for this module. After the meeting, write in the box above one concrete thing you saw in each person; you reread them before module 7.
friend.plan.help: The plan opens on the variant chosen in Settings; the other two are below, one tap away.
settings.title: Settings
settings.role.help: What I do on this device.
settings.config: How we go through the course
settings.config.help: In each module, the "With your Dream Friend" section opens on the chosen variant; the other two stay one tap away.
settings.lang: Interface language (the course text is in Romanian)
settings.danger: Delete all data on this device
settings.danger.confirm: Delete everything? This cannot be undone. Save a copy first if you want to keep anything.
settings.privacy: Nothing leaves this device. The files saved from here are the only way data goes out, and only you start them.
role.help.dreamer: I work on my own dream. I see the modules, the dream list and the book.
role.help.friend: I accompany someone else on the road to their dream. I do not do the course exercises; I bring a few dreams of my own to the first meeting and prepare something small (10–20 minutes) for each meeting. The Dreamer uses the app on their own phone, with the Dreamer role; here I see the meeting plans and my notes.
role.help.both: I do the course and I am also the Dream Friend: by turns, in a peer pair, or all the time, when I lead a group and keep my own list too.
config.help.solo.dreamer: I work on my dream and someone close accompanies me at the seven meetings (1.5–2 hours each, every two weeks), without doing the course themselves. For each meeting the Dream Friend prepares something small of their own (10–20 minutes) and, from module 4, receives one sentence a week from me.
config.help.solo.friend: I accompany one person at the seven meetings (1.5–2 hours each, every two weeks), without doing the course myself. For each meeting I prepare something small of my own (10–20 minutes) and, from module 4, I receive one sentence a week from the Dreamer.
config.help.pair: We are two and we both do the course: at every meeting we both do the exercise, each with our own dream, and one of us, by turns, leads the meeting from the plan, as Dream Friend.
config.help.group.dreamer: I do the course in a group of 3–8 Dreamers, led by a Dream Friend (2-hour meetings, every two weeks). We all enter in Settings the same first-meeting date and the same number of days between modules.
config.help.group.friend: I lead the meetings (2 hours, every two weeks) for 3–8 Dreamers who each work on their own dream, without doing the course myself. Everyone enters in Settings the same first-meeting date and the same number of days between modules.
sources.title: Sources and credits
combo.pairNeedsBoth: In a peer pair you both do the course and take turns leading the meeting as Dream Friend. That is why the role on this device becomes "Both".
combo.friendNoPair: With the Dream Friend role you cannot choose "Peer pair": a pair has no Friend who is not doing the course.
combo.bothNeedsPartner: With the role "Both" you need someone whose Dream Friend you are: choose "Peer pair" or "Dream Friend and a group".
picker.step1: Step 1 of 2: my role on this device
picker.step2: Step 2 of 2: how we go through the course
picker.pickRole: Choose a role to see the next step.
picker.pickConfig.dreamer: Choose: you work with a Dream Friend who is not doing the course, or in a group run by a Dream Friend.
picker.pickConfig.friend: Choose: you accompany one Dreamer, or you run a group.
picker.pickConfig.both: Choose: a pair in which you take turns leading the meetings, or a group that you lead while also keeping your own list.
settings.change: Change the role or how we go through the course
config.help.group.both: I lead the meetings and, alongside, keep my own dream list and worksheets, which I do at home. At meetings I work for the group: I read three dreams in module 1, otherwise I ask and listen. Nobody in this group is my Dream Friend; I choose my progress partner outside the group, before module 4. So that I can lead, in each module I do for myself at least the exercise I ask of the group; the other sheets can wait until after the course.
settings.export.help: Creates a file with all your data (dreams, plans, notes, settings), including the letter, the journal and your Dream Friend notes. Keep it as a backup; do not send it to anyone unless you want them to see it. Nothing is sent automatically.
settings.book.help: Everything you wrote, in one document you can read without the app: dreams, worksheets, journal, vision and notes. It opens in any notes app or text editor. A sealed letter stays sealed: the document shows only its date. To restore, use the backup copy above, not this document.
settings.share.help: "Send" opens the device's list of apps: put the file in Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive or an e-mail to yourself. The app never connects to any service by itself.
settings.import.help: Choose a file you saved from this app. Before anything changes, the app tells you what it replaces on this device. Do not load someone else's file.
mydream.title: My dream
mydream.none: You have not chosen a dream to work on yet. Choose one on the Dreams page, with the button "Choose this dream (I work on it)"; if you keep the list on paper, write it there in the box "The dream I work on (copied from the notebook)".
mydream.clarify.help: Answer in writing, with details you could photograph. Answers save themselves when you leave the box.
clarify.clarity.q: What does this dream look like in real life? What do you do, where, with whom, when?
clarify.clarity.placeholder: e.g. next summer, ten days on foot through the Apuseni mountains, with my sister, with a tent
clarify.imagine.q: Close your eyes: what do you see around you, as in a photograph? Light, places, objects, faces.
clarify.imagine.placeholder: e.g. fog in the valley in the morning, the backpack wet with dew, my sister making coffee on the stove
clarify.feel.q: What do you feel in that moment?
clarify.feel.placeholder: e.g. calm, pride that I kept going, tired and happy legs
clarify.anchor: Anchor (what ties you to this dream)
clarify.anchor.q: Why does this dream matter for who you are?
clarify.anchor.placeholder: e.g. because at 12 I promised myself I would see the mountains on foot, not from a car window
clarify.act.q: What is one small step you can take this week?
clarify.act.placeholder: e.g. I take my sister out for a coffee and tell her the plan
mydream.routes: Three routes to the same dream
mydream.routes.help: Three different ways the dream could come true. You do not choose one yet; you just see them all.
mydream.route.placeholder.1: e.g. ten days in one go, next summer
mydream.route.placeholder.2: e.g. three long weekends this year
mydream.route.placeholder.3: e.g. with an organised group, if my sister cannot come
book.col.question: Question I answer
week.title: My week
week.intro: Write 5–8 things you usually do in a week, at home or at work, plus one step toward your dream; then put each in the box that fits it. The list saves itself.
week.add.label: A thing I do
week.add.placeholder: e.g. answer messages for an hour
week.empty: The list is empty. Type the first thing in the field above; for example, what you usually do on Monday morning.
week.move: Put in the calendar this week
week.when: Day and hour in the calendar
week.reflect.1: Which box holds most of your things?
week.reflect.3: Can you move something from one box to another?
week.reflect.4: Which thing from "Plan" do you put in the calendar this week?
woop.title: The obstacle (WOOP)
woop.help: Four lines, in this order. For the obstacle, look for what you do when things get stuck, not what you lack from outside.
woop.wish.q: The chosen dream, in one sentence, as you clarified it.
woop.wish.placeholder: e.g. next summer, ten days on foot through the Apuseni mountains, with my sister
woop.outcome.q: The best thing that happens if it comes true. How do you feel then?
woop.outcome.placeholder: e.g. I feel strong and free; my sister and I have something of our own again
woop.obstacle.q: What in you stops you most often? A habit, an emotion, an excuse.
woop.obstacle.placeholder: e.g. in the evening, when I would have time to look up trails, I open my phone and do not stop
woop.plan.q: "If the obstacle appears, then I…": one concrete action, written in advance, with the obstacle in the "if" part.
woop.plan.placeholder: e.g. if it is 9 pm and I have the phone in my hand, then I put it to charge in the kitchen and open the notebook
mydream.section.friends: Module 4 · People with a good heart
habit.title: The small step
habit.help: One sentence in three parts. The step must be smaller than feels normal: under two minutes.
habit.anchor.q: Something you already do every day, after which the step comes.
habit.anchor.placeholder: e.g. After I pour my morning coffee,
habit.behaviour.q: A thing so small you can do it even on your worst day.
habit.behaviour.placeholder: e.g. I open the notebook and read the dream.
habit.celebration.q: What you do right after, to tell yourself "well done".
habit.celebration.placeholder: e.g. Then I smile and put a tick in the notebook.
habit.sentence.empty: Your recipe will appear here as one sentence.
habit.log.help: Each week, tick "the habit happened" if you did the small step on at least five days out of seven, and write the sentence you sent your progress partner. Keep the log until the end of the course and three months after.
habit.note.label: Sentence sent to the progress partner in the week of {date}
habit.note.placeholder: e.g. I opened the notebook 5 days out of 7 and looked up two trails
friends.title: People with a good heart
friends.help: Three people on your dream's side, one role each. It can be three people or the same person in two roles (write their name twice). Tell them what you did, not who you want to become.
friends.name: Person {n}
friends.role.friend: the one who is glad with me
friends.role.friend.help: Any close person who is glad when I tell them what I did and whom I look up to.
friends.role.progress.help: The one you write one sentence a week to, about what you did.
friends.role.ask: the person I ask something of
friends.role.ask.help: Advice, an introduction, an hour of help: something concrete.
friends.ask: My ask, written as a sentence I will actually say
friends.ask.placeholder: e.g. Mihai, you walked the Apuseni; can you give me an hour on Sunday to tell me which trail you would pick for two beginners?
friends.day: Day of the week I write to them
friends.print: Print the "People with a good heart" sheet
fear.title: Fear and good enough
fear.help: Two short answers. Fear is not a bad thing; it moves you, unless it freezes you.
fear.fear.q: What fear hides behind the obstacle you wrote on the "Obstacle (WOOP)" sheet?
fear.fear.placeholder: e.g. that I will embarrass myself if I do not last ten days
fear.goodEnough.q: What would "good enough" look like for your dream, so you do not wait for perfect?
fear.goodEnough.placeholder: e.g. three days on foot, with a tent, and wanting to go again
fear.print: Print the "Fear and good enough" sheet
book.sheet.friends: People with a good heart (from module 4)
calm.title: Calm
calm.intro: The voices that pull you back, the part of you that sees clearly, and a photograph of your life today. Everything saves itself.
profile.title: My saboteurs and strengths
profile.help: From the saboteur test (in English; the test names are in brackets) pick the three voices with the highest score, leaving out the Judge, which we all have; from the strengths questionnaire write the top five in your own words.
profile.saboteurs: The three voices with the highest score
profile.saboteurs.note: The names are given, playfully, to thoughts we all have; not a diagnosis and not a label about who you are.
profile.links: The full description of each voice, in English, on the Positive Intelligence site:
profile.links.sage: The guide to the five Sage powers, in English, on the Positive Intelligence site
profile.uses: A strength, used in a new way
profile.uses.help: One week, every day: a single strength, used in a new way, tied to the dream. Write what you did.
profile.uses.what: What I did with it today, differently from usual
profile.uses.placeholder: e.g. I called a mountain guide and asked him three things about the Apuseni
profile.print: Print the "My saboteurs and strengths" sheet
sab.judge.desc: The voice that scolds you for mistakes, scares you with what could go wrong and finds what is wrong with others and with life. We all have it.
sab.vigilant.desc: Constant worry: something will go wrong, be careful. Keeps you up at night and makes you check three times.
sab.achiever.desc: You are worth what you achieve. Today's success is never enough either; the next one will bring peace, but it does not.
sab.controller.desc: If you do not run it, it falls apart. You push others, get angry when they do not listen, cannot stand aside.
sab.stickler.desc: It is not good enough. Order, rules, everything in its place; a small mistake is a big shame.
sab.victim.desc: Nobody understands how much you suffer. It promises that if the suffering shows, help will come, and good things seem to happen to others.
sab.rational.desc: Feelings are a waste of time. You analyse everything from a distance, and people feel like noise in the way.
sab.pleaser.desc: You cannot say no. You give all the time, to be accepted, and silently resent not getting back.
sab.restless.desc: The next thing will be better. Always busy, always bored by what is now, hard to keep on one thing.
sab.avoider.desc: Better not get involved. You go around what is hard or unpleasant, postpone conflicts and call it peace.
journal.title: The "catch the saboteur" journal
journal.help: Every time you get angry, scared or stuck: five minutes, six lines. The last line is the one that matters.
journal.happened.placeholder: e.g. my boss asked me to redo the report
journal.thought.placeholder: e.g. I got it wrong again, I am not able
journal.felt.placeholder: e.g. shame, a knot in my stomach
journal.did.placeholder: e.g. I sat for an hour doing nothing
journal.friend: What I would tell a friend who was in my situation
journal.friend.placeholder: e.g. you have redone reports dozens of times; take it in pieces
journal.empty: No entry yet. Press "Write an entry" after the first time a voice catches you.
journal.print: Print the "Catch the saboteur journal" sheet
rep.title: The short attention exercise
rep.help: Notice the voice ("that is the Judge"), then move your attention to one sense until it rings. Once a day, two weeks.
rep.sense.touch: Rub two fingers together and feel the lines of the skin.
rep.sense.sound: Listen for the farthest sound you can catch.
rep.sense.breath: Breathe and feel the air going in and out through your nose.
rep.sense.sight: Look at one object and notice its colours and edges.
rep.sense.weight: Feel the weight of your body on the chair or on your feet.
rep.done: Done. What changed in your body?
rep.videos.help: Spoken in English, two minutes each, with Romanian and English subtitles: one on how the voices that hold you back can become gifts, one with a short guided attention exercise.
rep.videos.subtitles: Romanian subtitles start by themselves; switch or turn them off from the player's subtitle button.
rep.videos.credit: Recordings with Shirzad Chamine, from the Positive Intelligence program (on the Sources page).
wheel.title: Wheel of life
wheel.help: Eight slices, a score from 0 (not satisfied at all) to 10 (as satisfied as can be) for each. A photograph of today, not a test; you redo it at every vision check-in (at 3 or 6 months).
swls.title: Five statements about my life
swls.help: For each statement, how much you agree, from 1 (not at all) to 7 (completely). The questionnaire has been used in research since 1985 (on the Sources page, under "Life satisfaction").
swls.ideal: In most ways my life is close to my ideal.
swls.conditions: The conditions of my life are excellent.
swls.satisfied: I am satisfied with my life.
swls.gotten: So far I have gotten the important things I want in life.
swls.again: If I could live my life over, I would change almost nothing.
home.work.help: The sheets you fill in during the course. Next to each one it says which module it is from; before its module, a sheet is empty.
vision.title: The vision
vision.intro: The direction you want your life to take: your values, the letter from your future self and the vision sheet. Everything saves itself.
values.title: My values
values.help: Write ten things you care about. Then press the star on five of them and, on those you never give up whatever the cost, also press "never give up". For example: family and honesty.
values.placeholder.3: e.g. the freedom to choose my day
values.nonneg: I never give up, whatever the cost
values.legend: ★ = one of the five · "never give up" = a value you never give up whatever the cost
values.acts: What I did this week for a value
values.acts.help: After the meeting, in the same week: one concrete thing for one of the five values. Write what you did.
values.acts.placeholder: e.g. I called my mother for no reason
letter.title: The letter from my future self
letter.help: You are 10–15 years older (if that feels too far, at least 5) and you write to yourself as you are today. Answer the seven questions, in order, with details you could see. Then write today's reply. You seal the letter after the meeting.
letter.q.advice: What advice do you give the you of today?
letter.text: The letter, from my future self
letter.text.placeholder: e.g. It is Tuesday morning and I am drinking coffee on the porch of the country house. I hear the plum trees in the wind…
letter.reply.placeholder: e.g. I am glad you got there. Today I am afraid of…
letter.date: When the app should show it to me again
letter.date.help: Between 3 and 12 months from today. Until then you do not reread it.
letter.sealed.help: The letter and the reply stay here, hidden, until the chosen date. The app shows them again when you open this page after that date.
letter.delivered: The letter was sealed for {date}. It is open now: read it slowly.
letter.ics: Add the date to my calendar
letter.ics.title: The letter from my future self
letter.ics.body: Today the letter you wrote to yourself opens. Open Dream Book, the Vision page.
letter.print: Print the "Letter from my future self" sheet
sheet.title: The vision sheet
sheet.help: One sheet with nine boxes about the direction of your life. In module 6 you fill 1–4, in module 7 the rest. You reread it at every vision check-in (at 3 or 6 months).
sheet.matters.q: What do I truly value? What do I never give up?
sheet.matters.placeholder: e.g. time with my family; honesty; the freedom to choose my day
sheet.best: When I am at my best, I am…
sheet.best.q: In which moments did you feel strong, able, fulfilled?
sheet.best.placeholder: e.g. calm, curious, with a plan in hand and people around
sheet.energy.q: What gives me energy? What drains me?
sheet.energy.placeholder: e.g. gives energy: mountain walks, a finished thing; drains: meetings with no decision, the phone at night
sheet.tenYears: Ten to fifteen years from now
sheet.tenYears.q: I want to do more of… / I want to stop…
sheet.tenYears.placeholder: e.g. more: trips with my sister, working with my hands; stop: saying yes to everything
sheet.impact.q: What difference do I want to make? For whom?
sheet.impact.placeholder: e.g. my children seeing me do what I love; younger colleagues leaving me more confident
sheet.idealDay.q: What does a "normal, good day" look like? Work, life, mood.
sheet.idealDay.placeholder: e.g. up without an alarm, two hours of deep work, lunch with someone, evening without a screen
sheet.identity: How I want to be known
sheet.identity.q: I want to be known for… People come to me because…
sheet.identity.placeholder: e.g. for calling things by their name, gently; they come when they have something hard to decide
sheet.statement.q: I am a person who [who I am], creating [what I bring], living [how].
sheet.statement.placeholder: e.g. I am a person who keeps people close, creating places where they feel safe, living with my feet on the mountain
sheet.focus: Three directions for the next years
sheet.focus.q: Three themes that guide your choices, not detailed plans.
sheet.focus.placeholder: e.g. 1. legs and back health; 2. screen-free time with my family; 3. a craft
book.sheet.letter: The letter from my future self (from module 6)
letter.ics.help: A small file downloads; open it and the date goes into the calendar.
vision.section.regret: Module 7 · The view from 75 and the Yes and No lists
vision.section.checkin: After the course · The vision check-in
sheet.check: Check the sentence with three questions:
sheet.check.mine: Is it mine, not what others expect?
sheet.check.stretch: Does it take me a little out of the safe zone, not too comfortable?
sheet.check.decide: Would it help me say yes or no to an opportunity?
regret.title: The view from 75
regret.help: You are 75 and look back. For each of the four areas, write what you would regret not having pursued. Not a list of reproaches; a compass.
regret.q: What would I regret not having pursued?
regret.impact: What I would regret not having left behind
regret.impact.placeholder: e.g. that I never left my children a place of ours in the country
regret.relationships.placeholder: e.g. that I never spent whole summers with my sister
regret.growth.placeholder: e.g. that I never learned to work wood
regret.courage.placeholder: e.g. that I never set off on a journey alone
yesno.title: The Yes and No lists
yesno.help: Two lists and two questions. They are your filter: when an offer, a request or a path appears, hold it against the lists: is it a yes or a no?
yesno.yes: In my dreamed future, I say yes to…
yesno.yes.placeholder: e.g. trips with my sister; working with my hands; evenings without a screen
yesno.no: In my dreamed future, I say no to…
yesno.no.placeholder: e.g. meetings with no decision; polite yeses
yesno.changes: What changes would be needed to get there
yesno.changes.placeholder: e.g. work four days a week
yesno.hardest: The thing hardest for me to part with
yesno.hardest.placeholder: e.g. the habit of saying yes out of politeness
regret.print: Print the "View from 75 and the Yes and No lists" sheet
checkin.title: The vision check-in
checkin.help: The habit that matters most after the course: every 3 or 6 months, 30 minutes following the list below. The app shows the date and gives you the calendar file.
checkin.due: It is time for the vision check-in. Take 30 minutes, following the list below.
checkin.none: Choose "every 3 months" or "every 6 months" and the app computes the next date.
checkin.steps: What I do at a check-in (30 minutes)
checkin.step.vision: Reread the vision in one sentence, the three directions and the five values, on the Vision page, and ask whether the values will be the same in 10–15 years.
checkin.step.wheel: Redo the wheel of life and the five statements, on the Calm page, and compare with the earlier photograph.
checkin.step.dreams: Reread the 100 dreams list, score again, add new dreams, mark achieved ones.
checkin.step.directions: Ask whether the three directions are still mine; change what no longer is.
checkin.step.yesno: Reread the Yes and No lists and hold them against what I was asked in the last months.
checkin.step.letgo: If a dream has become a torment, open "Let the dream go with honour" on the My dream page.
checkin.note: One sentence about what I saw at today's check-in
checkin.note.placeholder: e.g. the wheel went up on health; direction 3 is no longer mine, I change it
checkin.ics.title: The vision check-in
checkin.ics.body: 30 minutes: open Dream Book, the Vision page, the Vision check-in section.

letgo.title: Let the dream go with honour
letgo.help: When a dream has become a torment, not a defeat: with open eyes. You do not have to decide the same day: leave the sheet a week, tell your progress partner what you wrote, then press. A dream let go stays in the list, with the date, and you can pick it up any time.
letgo.sign.oscillate: I keep wondering whether to go on or to stop.
letgo.sign.sleep: I lose sleep or peace over it.
letgo.sign.stalled: The small steps have not happened for weeks.
letgo.sign.outside: I keep it for others, not for me.
letgo.costs.placeholder: e.g. every weekend, and Sunday sleep
letgo.benefits: What it brings me if I see it through
letgo.benefits.placeholder: e.g. the pride of finishing; not much else
letgo.replacement: Which dream from my list would take its place
letgo.replacement.placeholder: e.g. three days on foot, with a tent, instead of ten
letgo.released: The dream was let go on {date}. It stays in the list, marked, not deleted. Choose another from the 100 dreams list.
letgo.continued: You decided on {date} to continue. Come back here any time.
letgo.print: Print the "Let the dream go with honour" sheet

dreamerOnly.text: This page is for the Dreamer. On this phone the chosen role is Dream Friend; the Dreamer fills in the sheets on their own phone. The meeting plans are on the Dream Friend page. If you want to work on a dream of your own too, change the role in Settings.
module.friendNote: You are the Dream Friend: the boxes on this page are filled in by the Dreamer, in their own app. The plan of this meeting, with timings and questions, is on the Dream Friend page; you write your notes there too.
settings.import.confirm: Load this backup? The dreams on this device ({now}) are replaced by the ones in the file ({file}), together with its sheets, notes and settings. This cannot be undone: if you want to keep what is here now, save a copy first.
settings.import.confirm.dated: Load the backup saved on {date}? The dreams on this device ({now}) are replaced by the ones in the file ({file}), together with its sheets, notes and settings. This cannot be undone: if you want to keep what is here now, save a copy first.
settings.import.confirm.kept: Whatever the file does not contain stays as it is on this device.
settings.import.dropped: {n} rows of the file did not fit the app and were left out or corrected.
settings.import.err.notBackup: The file could not be read. Choose the copy saved from this app (a .json file, or .json.txt if it was sent with “Send the copy…”).
settings.import.err.tooLarge: The file is too large to be a copy of this app. Choose the copy it saved (.json or .json.txt).
settings.import.err.write: The backup could not be loaded: the browser refused to save. The data on this device is unchanged.
settings.danger.blocked: Deleting is waiting: the app is also open in another tab or window. Close them and the delete finishes by itself.
crash.app: The app could not show this page. Your data is still on this device. Reload the page; if the problem stays, save a copy.
crash.storage: This browser does not let the app keep its data: it may be a private window, or storage is blocked for this site. Open the app in a normal window or allow storage for this site, then reload the page.
crash.wipe.help: If it still does not work after a reload, you can delete the data on this device and then load your saved copy.
page.error: This page could not be shown. The other pages work; reload the page, or open Settings to save a copy.
page.offline: This page did not load: the device seems to be offline. When the connection is back, reload the page.
save.failed: The last change was not saved.
save.failed.quota: The browser's storage is full. Save a copy from Settings, free some space in the browser, then type again.
save.failed.other: The browser refused to save. The text stays in the box; try again in a moment, and if it still fails, save a copy from Settings.
module.done.undo: It has not taken place yet
letter.new.confirm: The current letter moves to the letters already read, and a new one starts here. Continue?
